intro: A short horror visual novel inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends, where familiar places become home to inexplicable and disturbingly real horrors.
description:
Horror in everyday life always begins in the most ordinary way.

A late-night subway station. A movie theater with only a single audience member. A mountain road swallowed by dense fog. A bedroom where you lie alone after work. Even the bathroom of an ordinary apartment.

Every story begins in places that feel familiar. Then, without warning, something inexplicable slips into the ordinary.

Scary Stories: Grotesque is a collection of short horror visual novels inspired by internet ghost stories and urban legends.

Some stories begin with something someone else once experienced. Others begin with a single careless mistake. And in most cases, the protagonist never truly discovers what they encountered.

New ghost stories will continue to be added through future updates. More horrors are waiting to invade your everyday life.

Have you ever...

Fallen asleep on the subway and missed your stop?

Watched a movie alone in an empty theater?

Walked home alone late at night?

Fumbled for a power outlet in a dark room?

Truly hated someone?

Driven down a deserted road in the middle of the night?

Scary Stories: Grotesque gathers the unsettling tales that may have been hiding between those ordinary moments.

Face every kind of horror you can imagine.

From slow-building psychological dread, to nerve-racking jump scares, to the overwhelming despair of cosmic horror.

Experience every boundary of fear, all in one place.

Key Features

Horror That Feels Real - The scariest thing isn't ghosts—it's the feeling that it could really happen. Experience a creeping sense of dread that slowly tightens its grip within familiar places.

Anthology Format - A collection of short, intense ghost stories. Enjoy each story at your own pace, anytime and anywhere, with every tale delivering a different flavor of horror.

Paranormal Photo-Inspired Visuals - Aged film photography, heavy noise, and low-light cinematography. Designed to recreate the disturbing realism of browsing paranormal photo archives and ghost story forums late at night.

Immersive Sound Design - Every breath, every creak, every distant sound is crafted to keep you on edge. Atmospheric music and unsettling sound effects bring each story vividly to life.

Things Left Unexplained - Not every mystery is solved when the story ends. What did you really see? What was actually there? The answer is yours alone.
